title: Long-Distance Movers in Newport Beach | SOS Moving
metaDescription: Long distance movers in Newport Beach: one flat rate, a truck only for you, and loading days planned around street permits and Newport Coast gates.
heroSubtitle: A dedicated truck, one flat price and a crew that plans your loading day around Newport Beach permits, gates and freeway routes

faq.question: How is the price set for a long-distance move from Newport Beach?
faq.answer: You get a single flat figure for the whole truck instead of an hourly bill. We base it on your inventory, the destination, any packing you want from us and the access at both addresses. Send the list or call 909-443-0004, and the quote costs nothing.

faq.question: My home is in a gated Newport Coast enclave. What do I need to arrange?
faq.answer: Get the move rules from both the Newport Coast Community Association and your enclave's sub-association, since both may apply. Put the crew on the gate access list for the loading date. Should either one want our certificate of insurance, it costs $50 and goes straight to their office.

faq.question: Do I have to post No Parking signs for the truck?
faq.answer: Only if the truck needs to hold street space. In that case the Temporary Street Use Permit from Public Works comes with the signs, and you must post them and notify Police dispatch at least 72 hours ahead. A driveway or private lot that fits a 26-ft truck usually removes the need for a permit.

faq.question: What happens if my new home in another state is not ready?
faq.answer: We can keep your things in climate-controlled in-transit storage until the keys are yours. The crew loads in Newport Beach, stores the shipment and delivers it on the date you give us. The storage term can be extended without penalties.

faq.question: Can you start a long-distance move the same day I call?
faq.answer: We do take same-day moves when a crew and truck are open, within our 8AM – 6PM hours. In Newport Beach the limit is usually the curb: a street permit needs 72 hours of notice before the signs can be enforced. Same-day pickups therefore work best from a driveway or a private lot.
